issues.issue: Did the application judge properly exercise his discretion to certify serious questions of general importance, so that an appeal lies?
issues.applicant_position: Counsel proposed the questions the judge certified, so the appeal should proceed on them.
issues.respondent_position: Questions do not transcend the parties, are not dispositive, were already answered or are not serious questions of general importance.
issues.result_quote: In my opinion, he did not. As a result, the pre-condition to Mr. Carrasco Varela's right of appeal has not been met
